planets.name: WASP-161 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Tislit with a 5.41-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: WASP-161 b was found in 2018 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Tislit. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
